title: Junior Architect (Residential Projects)
description:
**An architecture practice based in Tatbad, Coimbatore\- is hiring a Junior Architect with 0–2 years of experience to support residential architecture projects. The role involves assisting with design development, technical documentation, consultant coordination, and project execution.** 




  





**Project Exposure** 





 Work may include:
 



* Residential architecture projects
* Residential interior projects
* Custom home design
* Design development
* Construction documentation



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Assist in developing architectural concepts, layouts, and design proposals.
* Prepare presentation drawings, design development drawings, working drawings, and construction documentation.
* Produce plans, elevations, sections, and architectural details.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, and other consultants during project development.
* Support material selection and architectural detailing.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and project teams during execution.
* Participate in site visits to review progress and support implementation of design intent.
* Maintain project drawings and documentation throughout different project stages.
* Support timely delivery of architectural documentation and project deliverables.



  





**Requirements** 



* **Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch).**
* **0–2 years of internship or professional experience in architecture.**
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, and architectural presentation or visualization software.
* Understanding of architectural planning, drafting, technical documentation, and detailing.
* Familiarity with residential construction methods and building materials.
* Ability to prepare presentation drawings, working drawings, and technical documentation.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with consultants, contractors, and project teams.
* Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple project tasks.



  





**Work Schedule** 



* **Location:** 

   Tatabad, Coimbatore
* **Working days:** 

 Monday to Saturday (9:30 am to 6:30 pm)
